assessments.reasoning: The Go 1.23 specification requires a new backing array when the resulting length would exceed the destination capacity. It sets a lower bound on the new capacity.

challenge.method: Check a slice of length two and capacity four with two additional elements, then with three.
challenge.results: Two fit exactly and the existing array is reused. Three require a new array with capacity of at least five. The clause supplies no exact growth factor.

limitations: The specific capacity of the new array is unspecified by this clause.
